title: seat.taken payload, schemaVersion 1
description: Someone sat down. Player names are not unique; seat identity is its own thing (the seatId). Spectators never take a seat — they need nothing.

seatId.description: A short GUID identifying this seat-taking. Seat identity is distinct from the player's display name.

tablePosition.description: Which of the table's 1-4 slots this seat occupies. Distinct from seatId, which is the seat's own identity.

playerName.description: Display only. Not unique, not an identity.
